notes.subject: מפני
notes.rationale: 'before the face of' vs 'because of' — versions differ sharply: KJV/ASV 'before darkness', BSB 'by the darkness'

notes.subject: חשך/אפל
notes.gloss: chokokue añónte opaite kotýpe: chokokue tuichavéva ndaipóri avañeʼẽme
notes.rationale: two darkness words rendered with one; אפל 'thick gloom' lost

notes.subject: נצמתי
notes.gloss: oñemoĩ — 'ojejopy hi'ári' ikatu oreko pe he'iséva
notes.rationale: 'extirpated/silenced before darkness' — BSB 'silenced' vs KJV 'cut off'

translation: Che ndahaʼéi oñemoĩvaʼekue chokokue ndive; ha oñemokañy chokokue che ára rehe.
